title: Reject resumed activation history when current tool schemas are unavailable
wanted_capability: Fail locally before any provider or compaction request when trusted activation evidence promises a client tool whose schema is absent from the current request. Preserve permissions and allow consistent/legacy-recovered sessions.
evidence: captured exact-request controls: missing bro_report schema triggers spurious native searches on flagship and Flash; restored schema calls report directly
notes: Operator authorized preflight guard with acceptance zero provider requests for missing-schema controls. Check saved activations and successful paired tool_search receipts including explicit-empty snapshot, denied tool, and missing catalog; no restoration of disallowed tool. Implementation in progress.
resolution_note: Implemented and pushed in 841b286b plus 9453ff81. Saved activations and paired successful tool_search receipts from event logs/native snapshots require current permitted wire schemas; otherwise admission emits durable error.resume_tool_schema_missing before model/compaction. Explicit [] cannot erase receipts, legacy absent fields recover permitted activations, and saved-only evidence survives pinned/eager transitions. Final lane full-profile harness tests: 523 passed, 3 skipped. Clippy passed with warnings; pinned formatter and native arm64 build passed. Nine offline process cases passed on built and installed binary; all four refusal cases made zero provider requests. Live Flash/flagship controls at 841b286b: 12 provider requests, zero native searches in arithmetic/report controls; both lost-activation resumes refused with zero provider requests. Stable-signed 9453ff81 installed on host Fleet with unchanged designated requirement and backup. Normal Fleet code-mode dispatch/resume passed; explicit top-level activation followed by policy denial failed immediately with durable num_turns 0. Code-mode-only use without flat activation is outside this guard's requirement set. Original provider consistency and mixed duplicate-call gaps remain open. See design/bro-harness/glm-native-search-validation.md.
